name: GSE247450 embryonic endothelial MERFISH
modality: MERFISH, released 315-gene matrix in the validated E9.5 sample
stages: E9.5 WT (two sagittal regions) and E15.5 WT
license_note: GEO itself places no restrictions on use/distribution of deposited molecular data, but NCBI notes that submitters may retain third-party rights. Cite the study and accession; do not infer a dataset licence from the article licence.

t1.note: E9.5 is released training time and E15.5 is after the protected extrapolation window.

t2-embryo.note: Neither stage is inside the embryo interpolation window.

t2-heart.note: E9.5 is allowed and E15.5 is after E13.5.

t3.note: The listed MERFISH samples are WT; genotype legality still needs separate review for any additional source.

name: GSE282547 developing mouse-heart spatial atlas
modality: 10x Visium and Curio Slide-seq spatial transcriptomics
stages: embryonic and neonatal heart series; use only stages allowed by the current VEC rules
license_note: GEO itself places no restrictions on use/distribution of deposited molecular data, subject to possible submitter rights. The associated 2026 article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, which is an article licence, not a blanket licence for every deposited data file.

t1.note: Do not use measured data after E9.5 through E13.5 inclusive; stages after E13.5 are allowed if disclosed.

t2-embryo.note: Apply the current VEC stage rules to every sample; this atlas is heart-focused rather than whole embryo.

t2-heart.note: E10.5 and E12.5 are held out and the extrapolation window through E13.5 is protected. E14.5+ is outside that window and may be used if disclosed.

t3.note: Use WT samples only unless a perturbation/genotype has been separately audited.

name: Mouse Gene Ontology annotations
modality: curated gene-function annotations, not measured embryo expression
license_note: Gene Ontology data products are CC BY 4.0. Attribute the Gene Ontology Consortium and record the exact release/date used.

t1.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t2-embryo.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t2-heart.note: Functional annotations are not a measurement of a held-out embryo stage.

t3.note: Potentially useful for perturbation identity; disclose the exact GO release.

name: Extended Mouse Atlas (E6.5–E9.5 scRNA-seq)
size_note: 430,339 cells; official downloadable package is a 25 GB archive
license_note: The project page provides the data but does not state a dataset-specific redistribution licence. Link to the upstream release and cite the paper; do not redistribute the atlas from this repo without clearer terms.

t1.note: All atlas stages are at or before the released E9.5 endpoint.

t2-embryo.note: Remove cells strictly between E7.25 and E8.0.

t2-heart.note: Remove cells strictly between E8.25 and E8.75, including E8.5.

t3.note: The main atlas is WT; genotype safety is not established by stage filtering alone.

name: sc3D / Slide-seq whole mouse embryo maps
stages: whole E8.5 and E9.0; partial E9.5
license_note: The molecular data are public through GEO, whose reuse disclaimer applies. The convenient E9.0 Figshare h5ad is a separate hosted object; check that record's terms before redistributing it.

t1.note: E8.5–E9.5 is before the protected extrapolation interval.

t2-embryo.note: These stages are after the protected (E7.25, E8.0) interpolation interval.

t2-heart.note: E8.5 is held out/protected; E9.0 and exact E9.5 are outside that interpolation window.

t3.note: The study includes mutant experiments. Use WT files only unless each perturbation is separately reviewed.

name: Tabula Muris adult mouse atlas
modality: single-cell RNA-seq across adult mouse tissues
license_note: Public atlas, but this catalog did not establish a clean current processed-file download/licensing path. Treat it as a historical candidate rather than a recommended source here.
best_for: broad adult tissue priors, if independently obtained and audited

t1.note: Legality by stage is not the problem; task relevance and reproducible access are.

t2-embryo.note: Developmentally distant and not validated here.

t3.note: No specific advantage over better-audited priors in this catalog.
